nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/user_turns.md — the laptop half of the corpus before merge: 793 verbatim human turns from 2026-07-06, same format as user_turns_all.md, with user_turns.jsonl as its machine-readable twin

The laptop half is a strict subset of the merged corpus: its 793 turns plus the desktop half's 127 are exactly the 920 in user_turns_all.md, with nothing removed at merge time and no overlap between the halves — the two share no uuid, no (timestamp, text) pair and no session. Its own extraction accounting is raw/EXTRACT_REPORT.md: 10,313 user-role records seen, 9,547 rejected by a named rule, 90 duplicates collapsed, 676 kept at the 08-03 pass, later extended by union to 793. Cite the merged corpus for intent; this file exists so the halves stay inspectable
